Game Ready GRPro 2.1 Cold Compression Unit - Clinic Quick Reference (sample)
Section 4: Error E3 (low water)
Fill the reservoir with cold water to the fill line, add ice, and reseat the connector hose until it clicks. Restart the unit.
Section 5: Contraindications
Do not use cold compression on patients with known Raynaud's phenomenon or over an open wound without clinician approval.
Section 6: Daily cleaning
Empty the reservoir at the end of each day and leave the lid open to dry.
